notes.title: will be released in DEMO before the NEXT FEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982360/cad2499fad1a892b8e1f134de0b4bdfbece49675.png[/img]

[h3]After continuous polishing and filling, "Siana Tales" DEMO finally to meet with players.[/h3]

[h3]We expect to release the free demo in mid-January and participate in the NEXT FEST. [/h3]

[h3]Welcome to play and experience, and make valuable suggestions.[/h3]
